title: polypodium excaudatum
intro: Polypodium excaudatum, commonly known as the Chinese polypodium or Shou Wu, is a type of fern plant native to China and other parts of Asia. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including improving liver function, enhancing digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium excaudatum include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties, which help to protect against oxidative stress, inflammation, and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include polypodine, polyprenyl, and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
